selected_script.angle: A home cook deals with a dangerous stack of wet dishes slipping on a soggy counter, resolved instantly by assembling the double-tier matte black rack and routing water into the sink.
selected_script.hook: Stop stacking your wet dishes like a Jenga tower that's about to collapse!

script_record.0-3s: Close-up of wet plates and bowls slipping on a small soggy towel on a cluttered countertop, causing water to pool.
script_record.3-6s: Hands place the matte black base on the counter and snap the upper rack side bracket into the base slots with a quick push-down.
script_record.6-10s: First-person view hanging the side utensil caddy and cutting board holder onto the outer wire frame.
script_record.10-14s: Close-up under the tray as the 360-degree retractable drain spout is rotated and extended over the sink basin edge.
script_record.14-18s: Drying rack fully loaded with 11 plates and bowls, with water draining smoothly out of the spout into the sink.
script_record.18-20s: CTA: Keep your kitchen dry and organized. Get yours today.
